title: Candy Refill Velocity by Hour
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=candy:counter refill=true
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| stats count as refills, avg(candies_added) as avg_added by hour
| sort hour
description: Shows the busiest times for candy-bowl refills during seasonal events.
value: Refill timing reveals the real traffic rush much better than the total count at the end of the night.
implementation: Track refill events and quantity added in `index=personal`; summarize refill timing by hour.
visualization: Hour-by-hour chart of candy refills and average candies added.
grandmaExplanation: It spots what time the candy bowl needs refilling fastest, which is the clearest clue about the real rush.
